ways.label: Mautohe Cathedral Cove Track

start.name: top of Grange Road, Hahei
start.quote: the top of Grange Road, Hahei

via.name: Cathedral Cove Gateway Trail junction
via.quote: junction with the private Cathedral Cove Gateway Trail

evidence: Mautohe Cathedral Cove Track starts at the top of Grange Road, Hahei.
After the junction with the private Cathedral Cove Gateway Trail, the track descends steeply to Mares Leg Cove.
Return to the car park the same way you came.

access_points.name: Cathedral Cove Gateway Trail car park
access_points.quote: Cathedral Cove Gateway Trail car park at 150 Lees Road, Hahei

doubts: Hahei Visitor Car Park and the Gateway Trail car park are given as places to park/walk from to reach the track entrance (30 min walk or shuttle), recorded as access points. Boat/kayak access to the cove is not a way out of the walk.
